VdbeState.doc: Mutable execution state: register file, cursor slots, program counter, return stack, aggregate and window sessions. Sub-parts use the methods declared below; direct field access is forbidden.

AggFuncKind.doc: Runtime tag for aggregate function kind. Shared by opcodes-agg (directly) and opcodes-window (as payload of WindowKind::Aggregate). State uses this to select per-kind accumulator shape, step logic, and finalization rule.

WindowKind.doc: Runtime tag for window function kind. RowNumber/Rank/DenseRank are rank-style (no argument); Aggregate(kind) reuses an aggregate accumulator as a per-row window output.

RowSink.doc: User-supplied callback invoked for each EmitRow outcome. Reads state.get_register(start_reg + i) for i in [0, count) to observe the emitted row. MUST NOT mutate state. Each target picks the idiomatic callable representation: bare function pointer (Rust/C/Zig), function value (Go), callable object (Python). Capture / lifetime are the caller's responsibility.

Opcode.doc: Flat tagged union over the seven opcode families. Dispatch matches outer tag and delegates to the family's execute. No additional classification layers — Correctness pin #1.

Expr.doc: Pure-register arithmetic, comparison, coerce, like, etc.

Control.doc: Goto / If / IfNot / JumpIfNull / Gosub / Return.

Program.doc: Compiled bytecode plus sizing, plus the row-emission callback. Produced by the compiler; consumed by execute_program.

VdbeState.name: num_registers
VdbeState.doc: Upper bound of the register file; Register values are in [0, num_registers).

VdbeState.name: get_register
VdbeState.doc: Immutable view of the value in register r. Panics on out-of-bounds — caller (well-formed program) must not trigger.

VdbeState.name: set_register
VdbeState.doc: Move v into register r, releasing any prior owned payload.

VdbeState.name: take_register
VdbeState.doc: Move the value out of register r and return it as an owned Value; the register is left holding Value::Null. Panics on out-of-bounds — caller (well-formed program) must not trigger. This is the Move-without-clone primitive: Text/Blob payloads are transferred, not copied.

VdbeState.name: pc
VdbeState.doc: Current program counter.

VdbeState.name: set_pc
VdbeState.doc: Set the program counter. Caller ensures pc is within the Program.

VdbeState.name: return_stack_push
VdbeState.doc: Push a return address onto the Gosub/Return stack. Returns Err(OpcodeIllegal) if depth exceeds RETURN_STACK_MAX_DEPTH.

VdbeState.name: return_stack_pop
VdbeState.doc: Pop the top return address. Returns Err(OpcodeIllegal) if the stack is empty.

VdbeState.name: cursor_is_open
VdbeState.doc: True iff the cursor slot currently holds an open handle.

VdbeState.name: cursor_borrow
VdbeState.doc: Borrow the open cursor handle at slot c for a read-only call into storage (e.g., cursor_idx_rowid). Panics on empty slot — caller (well-formed program) must have opened the cursor first. Ends when the returned borrow goes out of scope; state remains borrow-accessible.

VdbeState.name: cursor_mut
VdbeState.doc: Mutably borrow the open cursor handle at slot c for a mutating call into storage (e.g., cursor_seek_ge, cursor_idx_next). Panics on empty slot. Scoped — the slot returns to normal access once the returned borrow ends. Replaces the first-pass take-operate-reinstall idiom used when only take_cursor was exposed.

VdbeState.name: set_cursor
VdbeState.doc: Install a cursor handle at slot c, releasing any prior handle at that slot (replace-on-write).

VdbeState.name: take_cursor
VdbeState.doc: Move out the cursor handle at slot c. Leaves the slot empty. None if already empty (idempotent). Used by Close to extract the handle before routing through storage.close_cursor. For read/mutate ops within a cursor's lifetime, prefer cursor_borrow / cursor_mut.

VdbeState.name: db
VdbeState.doc: Borrow the storage database handle. Used by OpenRead/OpenWrite and by any opcode that calls into storage.

VdbeState.name: aggregate_reset
VdbeState.doc: Reset the accumulator at slot to its per-kind initial state. The kind parameter pins the accumulator shape for this slot until the next reset. Implementation selects: CountStar/Count/CountDistinct → integer counter (+ distinct set where applicable); Sum/Total/Avg → numeric tracker; Min/Max → best-value holder; GroupConcat → buffer + separator + first-flag.

VdbeState.name: aggregate_step
VdbeState.doc: Apply regs[arg_reg] to the accumulator at slot under kind. State reads the register internally (avoids &Value + &mut self conflict in strict-borrow targets). NULL-skip rule: if kind != CountStar and regs[arg_reg] is Value::Null, do nothing (standard SQL aggregate NULL semantics). For GroupConcat, sep_reg names the register holding a user-supplied separator Value (expected Text); Some overrides the default ',' separator; None keeps the default. For non-GroupConcat kinds, sep_reg is ignored. Panics if the accumulator was never reset — compiler emits Reset before any Step.

VdbeState.name: aggregate_final
VdbeState.doc: Finalize the accumulator at slot and return its value. Empty-group rules: Count* → Integer(0); Sum → Null; Total → Real(0.0); Avg → Null; Min/Max → Null; GroupConcat → Null. Non-empty: Count* → Integer(n); Sum → Integer if int-only, else Real; Total → Real; Avg → Real(sum/count); Min/Max → best Value seen; GroupConcat → Text(buffer). After Final, the slot is semantically consumed; the next Reset re-initializes.

VdbeState.name: aggregate_value
VdbeState.doc: Read the current value of the accumulator at slot WITHOUT finalizing or consuming it. Same value-shape rules as aggregate_final, but the accumulator remains live for further Step calls. Used by WINDOW (per-row read) and HAVING post-group-close. Returns owned Value (cloned from accumulator state where needed).

VdbeState.name: window_open
VdbeState.doc: Allocate a window session at slot. Initializes per-kind state (rank counter, tie-tracker, or inner aggregate accumulator). n_partition_keys and n_order_keys size the per-session key storage; set_partition_key / step logic populates them.

VdbeState.name: window_step
VdbeState.doc: Feed the current row into the window session at slot. State reads regs[arg_reg] internally when Some (avoids &Value + &mut self conflict in strict-borrow targets). For RowNumber: increment counter (arg_reg ignored, expected None). For Rank/DenseRank: compare current ORDER BY tuple against previous; increment counter with per-kind tie rules (arg_reg ignored). For Aggregate(k): forward regs[arg_reg] to the inner aggregate step under kind k; arg_reg = None is treated as NULL (standard skip rule applies for all kinds except CountStar). Partition boundary detection is driven externally: the compiler emits a window_close + window_open pair across partitions.

VdbeState.name: window_value
VdbeState.doc: Read the current window-function value. RowNumber/Rank/DenseRank → Integer. Aggregate(k) → aggregate_value under k.

VdbeState.name: window_partition_key
VdbeState.doc: Read the stored key_idx-th component of the current partition-key tuple. Used by the outer scan to detect partition boundaries. Returns Null if never set.

VdbeState.name: window_close
VdbeState.doc: Free the window session at slot. Releases any inner aggregate accumulator and key storage. Idempotent — closing an already-closed slot is a no-op.

VdbeState.name: new
VdbeState.doc: Allocate a fresh state. Sizing params size the register file, cursor slot table, aggregate accumulator table, and window session table. `db` is borrowed for the duration of the state. All slots initialized per the §"VdbeState implementation" invariants in master.md: registers = Null, cursor slots = empty, pc = 0, return stack empty, aggregate/window slots empty.

execute_program.doc: Main dispatch loop. Canonical pseudo-code in §"Execution loop" of master.md. Signature is CANONICAL: caller constructs VdbeState via VdbeState.new first, then hands it to execute_program. The loop does NOT own the Database or the state. This keeps state lifetime in the caller's hands for composition (multiple runs, warm reuse, golden harness replays).
